## Selected action callables reach a local request interface

The [action-output continuation](myhomeserver1-3.87.13-action-output.md) follows the selected BN3L first and duration-related callable adapters beyond their earlier bindings. Distinct52-byte/24-byte captures reach two local blocks which assemble `jsonrpc`, `method`, `id`, `params` and request the same relocation-backed local output helper. These selected source edges do not establish method values, complete parameters, natural invocation order, prior-state restoration, delivery or physical effects. Descriptor/conversion/helper returns, object lifetime and complete branch admission remain premises; no additional original execution is introduced.
